title: Toscana.
note: A Val d'Orcia evening ray marched in a shader, cut into thick horizontal gradient strokes, with a Deco sunburst and a cypress breaking out of the frame.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] ray marches a Tuscan valley in a [[WebGL]] shader, composed by hand: a winding white road lined with cypresses, a farmhouse on a knoll, two ridges and a far mountain in the haze, lit by a low sun with real shadows. Each 15 px row is two rays averaged and laid down as one thick rounded stroke, its gradient running left to right, thicker in the dark and thinner in the light, with a Deco sunburst cut into the sky strokes and the near cypress carrying on out over the frame. The title is [[Google Fonts]] Limelight, the third choice after Poiret One (the obvious Deco face) and Italiana (too light to hold a stroke), picked because its heavy stems take the same strokes on the same grid as the landscape; the details are Josefin Sans, drawn on [[Canvas]].
